'''Stepan Beril''' is the president of [[T. G. Shevchenko University]] in [[Tiraspol]], the capital of the partially recognised state of [[Transnistria]]. He has presided over the university with 14 faculties and 84 chairs, offering 54 different majors, since 1996.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2011-09-17|title=Первый вуз Приднестровья|url=http://www.spsu.ru/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=4&Itemid=47|access-date=2021-02-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110917174751/http://www.spsu.ru/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=4&Itemid=47|archive-date=2011-09-17}}</ref>
